people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Tyre

translations.web: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.
translations.bsb: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
translations.kjv: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
translations.asv: And Jesus went out thence, and withdrew into the parts of Tyre and Sidon.
